profile.name: Muhammad Mudasir
profile.bio: Specializing in Web Development, Mobile Apps, and Automation Bots. Transforming ideas into high-performance digital reality.
profile.aboutText:
I am a passionate Full Stack Developer who believes that code is art. My journey started with a curiosity for how things work, which evolved into a career of building complex, high-performance systems.

Whether it's architecting a robust SaaS platform, optimizing an Automation bots, or crafting a pixel-perfect 3D website, I bring the same level of dedication and precision. I don't just write code; I engineer solutions that solve real-world problems.

experience.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Delivered 20+ custom web applications and automation bots for international clients. Specialized in Next.js, React, and Python automation. Maintained a 5-star rating.

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
experience.description: Collaborated with senior developers to build responsive frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Improved website load speed by 40%.

Focused on Fundamentals of Programming, Computer Networks, and Database Systems. Secured excellent grades.
Completed secondary education with a major in Computer Science and Mathematics. Laid the foundation for a tech career.

projects.title: Reddit Growth Automation Bot
projects.description:
- Developed an AI-powered Reddit automation engine using Python and OpenAI GPT-4.
- Implemented proxy rotation and session warming to bypass anti-spam algorithms.
- Achieved scalable karma growth and targeted audience engagement.
projects.longDescription: A cutting-edge marketing automation tool built with Python. It leverages OpenAI's GPT-4 to generate context-aware posts and comments tailored to specific subreddits. The system includes an advanced 'Account Warmer' module that mimics human activity (scrolling, upvoting) to build trust scores and prevent bans, managed via a rotating proxy network.
challenges: Navigating Reddit's strict anti-spam filters and shadowban algorithms.
Generating AI content that mimics authentic human discussion styles.
Managing multiple concurrent sessions without cross-contamination.

projects.title: Facebook Marketplace Scraper
projects.description:
- Engineered a high-performance Chrome Extension for bulk data extraction from Facebook Marketplace.
- Automated pagination and dynamic DOM scraping, exporting structured CSV/JSON data.
- Implemented background workers to process thousands of concurrent listings efficiently.
projects.longDescription: A powerful browser extension engineered for e-commerce data analysis. It automates the scraping of thousands of marketplace listings in minutes, dealing with the complexity of infinite scrolling and dynamic DOM loading. The tool extracts granular details like pricing, location, seller rating, and description, exporting clean structured data (CSV/JSON) for immediate use.
challenges: Adapting to Facebook's frequent obfuscated class name changes.
Managing memory efficient storage for thousands of scraped objects.
Implementing retry logic for network instability during bulk operations.

projects.title: Google Maps Review Automation
projects.description:
- Designed an enterprise automation bot using Selenium and Python to manage Google Maps reputation.
- Engineered Gmail session persistence strategies to bypass CAPTCHAs and login blocks.
- Built a custom React dashboard for campaign management and competitor review tracking.
projects.longDescription: A sophisticated automation tool designed to manage Google Maps reputation at scale. The system uses a React frontend for campaign management and a powerful Python backend for browser automation. Key capabilities include session persistence (storing Gmail cookies to bypass login), intelligent posting algorithms to mimic human behavior, and auto-flagging of negative reviews.
challenges: Bypassing Google's advanced bot detection and CAPTCHAs.
Managing thousands of Gmail cookies securely without invalidation.
Simulating realistic mouse movements and typing speeds.

projects.title: React Native Calculator
projects.description:
- Built a professional computational tool with scientific operations using React Native and Math.js.
- Implemented persistent calculation history and robust mathematical parsing engines.
- Ensured layout consistency and fluid animations across iOS and Android devices.
projects.longDescription: A robust, enterprise-ready scientific calculator application designed for precision and reliability. Built on the React Native framework, it implements a custom mathematical parsing engine to handle complex operations with zero latency. The interface adheres to strict iOS/Android design guidelines, ensuring a native look and feel.
challenges: Developing a custom parser to handle operator precedence correctly.
Managing state effectively to allow for instant history retrieval.
Ensuring 100% layout consistency across diverse screen sizes.

projects.title: React Native Stop-Watch
projects.description:
- Developed a high-accuracy chronometer app with millisecond precision and background execution.
- Implemented battery-efficient lap tracking and persistent state management using AsyncStorage.
- Designed a minimalist, high-contrast UI optimized for strictly smooth 60fps rendering.
projects.longDescription: An industry-standard timing application that provides reliable stopwatch and timer functionality. It deals with critical challenges like background execution and state persistence, ensuring timing accuracy even when the app is minimized. The UI is designed for high legibility and rapid interaction.
challenges: Synchronizing timer state between foreground and background services.
Preventing thread blocking to ensure smooth 60fps UI updates.
Handling device-specific power saving modes.

projects.title: Perplexity AI Search Clone
projects.description:
- Architected an enterprise AI search engine synthesizing real-time web data using Next.js and LangChain.
- Integrated OpenAI GPT-4 with Pinecone vector similarity search for deep research capabilities.
- Engineered edge-runtime AI streaming responses with rigorous citation tracking.
projects.longDescription: A sophisticated research tool that redefines web search. Built with Next.js and LangChain, this application synthesizes complex answers from live web data using OpenAI's GPT-4. It features a streaming interface for instant feedback, rigorous citation tracking for reliability, and a 'Copilot' mode that asks clarifying questions to refine search intent.
challenges: Orchestrating multi-step LLM chains (Search -> Read -> Synthesize) efficiently.
Reducing latency for a 'instant' search feel using Edge streams.
Implementing vector similarity search for retrieving relevant context.

projects.title: MernGPT AI Chatbot
projects.description:
- Built a secure conversational AI mobile app seamlessly integrating OpenAI GPT-4 and Google Gemini.
- Developed a scalable Node.js/MongoDB backend with JWT authentication for encrypted chat history.
- Implemented real-time streaming responses and syntax highlighting for generated code blocks.
projects.longDescription: A cutting-edge mobile chatbot application that bridges the gap between major LLMs. Users can switch between OpenAI's GPT-4 and Google's Gemini Pro models seamlessly. The app features a robust Node.js/MongoDB backend for storing chat history and user preferences, secured with JWT authentication. The React Native frontend delivers a fluid, futuristic chat interface.
challenges: Handling streaming API responses for a 'typing' effect.
Securing API keys and user data with proper encryption.
Optimizing MongoDB queries for retrieving long chat histories.

projects.title: Smart Notes App
projects.description:
- Created a distraction-free note-taking application using React Native and local AsyncStorage.
- Implemented robust real-time search algorithms, filtering, and offline-first data architecture.
- Designed color-coded organization systems and fluid CRUD state manipulation.
projects.longDescription: A lightweight yet powerful note-taking app designed for speed and simplicity. Built with React Native, it features instant load times and keeps data private using secure local storage. The robust CRUD operations allow users to manage their thoughts effortlessly, while the clean UI ensures a distraction-free writing environment.
features: Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) Operations
challenges: Managing efficient state updates for large lists of notes.
Implementing a smooth search algorithm that filters instantly.
Ensuring data persistence across app restarts without lag.

projects.title: Chef's Canvas Recipe App
projects.description:
- Developed an interactive culinary app featuring step-by-step cooking modes and integrated timers.
- Engineered a smart Pantry algorithm matching user ingredients to available TheMealDB recipes.
- Optimized image caching and implemented Redux Toolkit for seamless infinite scrolling.
projects.longDescription: A visually stunning mobile application built with React Native that serves as a personal culinary assistant. Users can explore thousands of recipes, filter by dietary preferences (Vegan, Keto, etc.), and follow step-by-step cooking instructions with integrated timers. The app features a 'Pantry' mode to suggest recipes based on available ingredients, reducing food waste.
challenges: Optimizing image caching for smooth infinite scrolling.
Implementing complex state management for the Pantry algorithm.
Ensuring consistent typography and layout across iOS and Android.

projects.title: PayRoll Management System
projects.description:
- Architected a comprehensive desktop application in C# .NET for automated salary and tax calculations.
- Managed real-time employee attendance tracking and instant PDF payslip generation.
- Built a secure MySQL database backend focusing on strict data integrity and role-based access.
projects.longDescription: A robust desktop application designed to streamline the complex process of payroll management. Built with C# and .NET Framework, this system ensures accurate salary calculations, tracks employee attendance in real-time, and automates the generation of tax-compliant payslips. It features a secure MySQL database backend for reliable data storage and retrieval.
challenges: Implementing complex tax formulas and deduction logic.
Ensuring data consistency across simultaneous user sessions.
Designing a responsive WinForms UI for various screen resolutions.
